name: Milestone Birthday Bash
atmosphereVision: Cozy neighborhood harvest fair with acoustic music

eventConcept.title: Glow & Revelry Celebration
eventConcept.description: A thoughtfully curated birthday experience combining refined aesthetics with heartfelt hospitality, tailored for 100 cherished guests.
eventConcept.creativeDirection: Balance bold focal moments with intimate seating nooks. Ensure warm lighting, organic floral textures, and seamless pacing from welcome to departure.

allocations.reason: Private party lounge or outdoor venue
Sculptural tiered cake and interactive culinary stations
High-impact entrance balloon garland and backdrop
Music curation and interactive celebration games
Photo moment setup and curated guest favors

timeline.title: Curate Menu & Beverage Tastings
timeline.description: Finalize dietary alternatives and service style

timeline.title: Send Digital Invitations & Collect RSVPs
timeline.description: Distribute invitation copy and setup response tracking

timeline.title: Atmosphere & Decor Concept Finalization
timeline.description: Review floral swatches, balloon arrangements, and lighting

timeline.title: Final Headcount & Vendor Brief Dispatch
timeline.description: Deliver final counts and schedule run-sheet to all vendors

timeline.title: On-Site Walkthrough & Sound Check
timeline.description: Verify power points, arrival signage, and rain contingencies

questionsToAsk: What security deposits are required for cleanup?

tasks: Confirm bar licensing and glassware provision
questionsToAsk: Do you provide staffing and tableware?

tasks: Measure ceiling height for balloon or floral installations
questionsToAsk: Can elements be repurposed between ceremony and reception?

tasks: Prepare family and friend shot list
Confirm golden hour outdoor portrait timing
questionsToAsk: How soon are sneak peek photos available?
Do you have backup camera bodies and audio recorders?

personalizedIdeas.title: Sculptural Metallic Balloon Archway
personalizedIdeas.description: Organic asymmetrical arch mixing matte lilac, rose gold chrome, and clear confetti spheres.
personalizedIdeas.reason: Instant photogenic centerpiece for arrival moments.

personalizedIdeas.title: Interactive Midnight Dessert Wall
personalizedIdeas.description: A backlit peg wall featuring artisanal glazed treats and personalized congratulatory notes.
personalizedIdeas.reason: Engaging sweet-treat station that delights guests late in the evening.

personalizedIdeas.title: Personalized Celebration Trivia Duel
personalizedIdeas.description: Curated 10-question mobile trivia about the guest of honor with playful prize pins.
personalizedIdeas.reason: Breaks the ice and connects disparate friend groups instantly.

risks.description: Potential seasonal weather changes for outdoor elements
risks.mitigation: Reserve clear-top canopy or confirm indoor alternate salon 72 hours prior.

risks.description: Guest RSVP attrition or unnotified plus-ones
risks.mitigation: Set dietary buffer of 5% with caterer and send digital SMS reminder 5 days ahead.
Stagger vendor load-in windows in 30-minute intervals with a designated coordinator.

nextActions: Review and lock initial venue deposits
Share personalized invitation copy with co-hosts
